lcc_original: 上帝就給他們祝福說：『要繁殖增多，充滿全地，去征服它；也要管理海裏的魚、空中的飛鳥、和在地上行動的各樣活物。』
notes: LCC condenses UNV's two distinct clauses (וַיְבָרֶךְ / וַיֹּאמֶר) into one: 給他們祝福說 — WAH0853 (accusative 'them') attaches to 給他們, WH01288+WTH8762 (bless) attaches to 祝福, WAH09001+WH0559+WTH8799 (said-to-them) attaches to 說
{<WH0430>} kept implicit before 說: LCC does not repeat 上帝 as the explicit subject of the saying clause, matching UNV's implicit marker
UNV {<WAH0853>} (implicit accusative marker on 地面) — LCC has explicit 全地 for the same referent, so braces dropped per rule 3: 全地<WAH0853><WH0776>
LCC inverts UNV word order in the final NP: 行動的各樣 vs UNV's 各樣行動的 — tags redistributed to preserve LCC order: 行動的<WH07430><WTH8802>各樣<WAH09002><WAH03605>
LCC 去 (directional auxiliary before 征服) and 在 (locative particle in 在地上) are Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalent — both left unannotated
LCC uses 飛鳥 (flying birds) where UNV has 鳥 — both map to WH05775 (עוֹף); LCC uses 上帝 where UNV has 神 — both map to WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים)
